results.rationale: Consistency: red truck, roof equipment, compartment arrangement, wheels and gray setting remain recognizable; the front emblem is slightly reshaped. Instruction: the output retains the front three-quarter view with a broad windshield and grille, whereas the reference requires a perpendicular side profile with the long side compartments exposed. Quality: truck geometry, chrome, tires and lighting are coherent with no noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: pale backdrop remains, but the remaining bread contours, crust texture and positions change markedly. Instruction: three baguettes become two, removing only one instead of two; one baguette should remain. Quality: the rear loaf has an implausibly pinched, bent silhouette and the crust is visibly smeared, while the foreground loaf remains recognizable.
